reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: Alan Smithee
reviews.text: I first met Mr. Hall when he came out to my home in late April of 2020, walked me through my trees what was/wasn’t a problem, and after telling him another service reported all trees needed to be removed for $8,000, he showed me why the trees were clearly living and only a trim would be needed. His crew arrived on Memorial Day during our staycation, worked from 9-4 removing them, even removed a small fur tree in the garden and drilled/installed a chimney cap that was not originally discussed while they had the bucket truck there. They cleaned the area, loaded all debris in a trailer and made sure we were happy with their service. I would recommend them and hire them again.

reviews.author: Jeannie Perryman
reviews.text: Hall's Tree Services trimmed trees for me this week 1/14/2026 and I'm pleased with their work. Phil knows trees and how to correctly trim them....they left clean cuts on trees where they removed limbs and branches. Professional and friendly. They cleaned up the saw dust and twigs leaving a neat yard. I have an oak tree that needs trimming....I definitely will call on Hall's Tree Services for that job.

reviews.author: Mike Sieracki
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the tree trimming work they did! My trees were getting out of control, and they made them look neat and clean. Trimmed all the dead branches to make my trees look healthy once again as well.The crew was super friendly, showed up right on time, and made sure everything was cleaned up perfectly before they left. It’s so nice to find people who take pride in their work. Highly recommend! I will call Halls tree service again without doubt when needed.

reviews.author: Mary Gorry Photography
reviews.text: Very impressed by their tree removal service! Phil was very responsive & thorough throughout the process. We have found our go to tree guy for any future tree needs. Thank you!!

reviews.author: Chris Wimmer
reviews.text: Had a huge tree limb fall down right before the sell of our house, Halls came out and gave us a quote, beat two other quotes we had from other companies and got out the next day to complete the job. Priced very reasonably, quick service, exactly who we needed to get the job done fast before the new owner took over, would definitely recommend going with Halls Tree Service!

reviews.author: James Lee
reviews.text: Despite local tree services being swamped, Mr. Hall came out and gave us an estimate. His crew was able to remove two trees within a few weeks (the best estimate for this work from the only other service I could even talk to was six weeks out). The work was done safely and professionally, and the crew left the yard in great shape.

reviews.author: Jennifer Walston
reviews.text: Phil was a pleasure to work with. He gave us a fair price for a 20 plus year old oak tree. Kept us informed daily of progress and next steps. Highly recommend and would use Halls Tree Service again!

reviews.author: Nichole Young
reviews.text: We would recommend Halls Tree Service of Rocky Mount to anyone! They arrived when expected and did an excellent job cutting down 5 large trees for us. Hard working crew and cleaned the area up when finished. Very pleased!

reviews.author: Chuks Chinukwue
reviews.text: Halls tree service did an amazing job clearing the trees from the side of my home. The did it in a timely manner and the price was very affordable. I strongly advice you to use halls tree service next time you need some trees cleared of your property.

reviews.author: Ginger Taylor
reviews.text: If you are looking for someone to trim some trees or to cut down trees I highly recommend Hall's Tree Service. They are very professional and very courteous individuals. That is a rare combination today. Experts in the field of tree removal! My husband and I will definitely use their services again. Ginger Taylor

reviews.author: Jean Padgett
reviews.text: This tree service went above and beyond what was expected. We had limited funds but they treated us like we were any other customer. They trimmed surrounding dead limbs and took down a dead, very tall tree. They were amazing. There was no swearing. Humble, caring man. A man of GOD. What a blessing

reviews.author: Amber Viventi
reviews.text: Precision cutting! Alan came out to cut down a tree beside our house, right next to our power line. We had just planted a bunch of small trees that were right near the tree being cut down. We were prepared to lose a few of our new trees due to the big tree falling on them. Alan did not damage even one limb on our new little trees. He was friendly, courteous, and professional. I highly recommend!

reviews.author: Robin Mason
reviews.text: Great job removing a downed tree. I will call Hall again when another tree falls or any other tree work Fine people. You cannot do better than Hall.

reviews.author: Nick Bosrock
reviews.text: Couldn't have asked for better service! They went above, and beyond my expectations. Friendly! Professional! Knowledgeable, and we're genuinely concerned about the health of my trees. I'm a customer for life. My neighbors all love my new trees. They are absolutely beautiful Thanks guys! Your the best

reviews.author: Tanesha Gray
reviews.text: Theses guys went above and beyond for me! I had an a delivery that got moved up weeks in advance (outback building) and Hall’s managed to work me in (moved my scheduled service up) and get my trees down within the next 2 days in time for my delivery!! I was beyond grateful. I will definitely be using Hall’s Tree Service for future removals!

reviews.author: The Bearded Rooster
reviews.text: These guys went above and beyond what I asked for. The owner is a great guy. Quotes given were very fairly priced. Definitely using Halls Tree Service in the future.

reviews.author: Polly Myers
reviews.text: As always Hall's Tree Service was professional . This is the third time I have used them to trim/cut trees from my yard. I was very happy with the tree trimming and clean up. I would call them again should the need arise.

reviews.author: Jennifer Lambert
reviews.text: Hall’s Tree Service cut down & removed a huge tree right next to my house. They did a great job & cleaned up the area nicely. Will call them again next time I need any tree work.

reviews.author: Katherine McKeithen
reviews.text: They offered helpful advice about the long term care of my trees. They showed concern about my trees, not just their bottom line. They let me know that a couple of the trees I was targeting for removal did not need to be removed. I would certainly use them again and highly recommend them to others.

reviews.author: Kim Greene
reviews.text: Thank you, Hall's Tree Service for rescuing my cat, who had gotten himself stuck in a very tall tree. Hall's sent out a climber and in less than 30 minutes the cat was back down where be belongs. The climber knew what he was doing and he was very gentle with the cat. Thank you so much!

reviews.author: Christy B
reviews.text: We had a HUGE limb break that was hanging by a thread that was threatening our fence and our roof and not to mention storms/hurricane on the way. Frantically calling around noone seemed to care or want to help because it was late on Friday afternoon --- But Mr. Hall came. Him and his crew. And they worked hard and cut down the huge limbs at a very fair price and didnt damage the fence or roof (because they are good). I highly recommend their business.

reviews.author: Buie Holder
reviews.text: True experts in their craft! Hard working, honest and great to deal with. If I ever need trees cut down again, I'm calling Halls!

reviews.author: king jax Adams
reviews.text: 1st Google review ever for a first class operation! Thank you Halls Tree Service for helping keep the homesite safe for my elderly parents in Rocky Mount, NC. Sincerely appreciated!!

reviews.author: Dana Sanders
reviews.text: Halls did an excellent job of tree removal and trimming at our home during a trying time for the owner and workers. Would definitely recommend their service to others.

reviews.author: Mack Wiggins
reviews.text: Hall’s Tree Service was very helpful, knowledgeable, professional and courteous. I would highly recommend Hall’s Tree Service for tree work.

reviews.author: Michael Cooper
reviews.text: Mr. Hall was an absolute professional. Very knowledgeable in his craft. Went above and beyond what we had discussed. Completely satisfied with his service and would recommend this company to anyone.

reviews.author: Thomas Adcox
reviews.text: I had an urgent need for pruning to be done to an old oak in my yard. Phil came out, gave an honest quote, and showed up the next day for the job. Work was completed without any problem. Would definitely use again if needed. Thanks Phil!

reviews.author: Scott W
reviews.text: Very reasonable fees. Super fast and courteous. Team cut down an 80-ft tree leaning near my home, with hardly any evidence the tree had been there. Cleaned up well afterwards. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Debbie Morton
reviews.text: Halls Tree Service did a great job cutting my 2 trees down. The weather was against them but they worked threw it. I would use them for future jobs. Thanks again for your service.

reviews.author: Kaye Lemons
reviews.text: Had a large limb broken off being held up by a "Y" of a small tree, over my storage building, the day before IAN. Hall's took care of that problem plus cut many more dead limbs from my trees. One employee even helped me put my yard furniture in the garage before IAN. I was very pleased with their performance and value. Kaye Lemons

reviews.author: Ricky Thompson
reviews.text: Phil and his team did a great job. They came quickly and got the tree off my house fast enough to prevent further water damage. Left the job site very clean.

reviews.author: Diana Richard
reviews.text: Hall's came by weeks end as stated and dropped our dead maple and evergreen bush really quick and came back the next day to grind the stumps. While here, we discussed trimming other bushes as they are out of control. We're considering having them return to work on trimming and pruning.

reviews.author: Cassandra Lathrop (IntriguingMuse)
reviews.text: Super friendly, helpful, and thoughtful! Best price in town, and will work with you and your schedule!! Will definitely work with them again!!!

reviews.author: Crystal Daniel
reviews.text: Halls Tree service went above and beyond when the trimming hanging trees on my parent’s house. They were super happy with the service they received and will be using them again for any tree service needs!!!

reviews.author: Nancy Blount
reviews.text: The response time was reasonable and the work done to perfection. I definitely will use their services again and recommend them as well. Reasonable pricing also.

reviews.author: Kevin Ellis
reviews.text: Quick, efficient, and reasonably priced! The yard was left as if no one had been there. Definitely will call upon them again if needed.

reviews.author: Paula Lookabill
reviews.text: Very professional and efficient! Not only did we have some branches cut, but several of our neighbors also had work done. These guys are the ones to call!

reviews.author: HHHunter CoChapter
reviews.text: Hall’sTree Service was over and beyond what I expected. Many family and friends have requested your number they too want your services

reviews.author: Candace Davis
reviews.text: Hall’s Tree Service cut down & removed a huge tree limb. They did a great job & cleaned up the area nicely. Will call them again next time I need any tree work.

reviews.author: Shelia Wall
reviews.text: They removed a huge tree limb still partly in the tree. They were professionally and efficient in removing it. They also cleaned up so that it looks like it never happened. I was very satisfied.

reviews.author: Erin Jefferson
reviews.text: Removed a really tall hickory tree that was in a bad spot...Friendly, thorough, reasonable. Great crew and owner!

reviews.author: Emily Merritt
reviews.text: Very prompt response and reasonable quote. Removed fallen tree from our home in a timely manner and performed clean up after

reviews.author: Tim Bullock
reviews.text: Great Job they did on my Property, give me a great explanation on how it’s done . Really appreciate great Job they did !
